text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...All right!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I gave it my all!
I really did, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Matikanetannhauser can look that intimidating?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, I've heard rumors that she's actually quite the hard worker!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Talk about not judging a book by its cover...
Man, what a great race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Diamond Stakes came to a close, having generated far more excitement than anyone had anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text: Yes, hello. Yes, the race just finished a moment ago—...huh?

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text: Transferred to a different department... you say?!

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
B-But, um, I'm finally starting to understand
the Umamusume world, and it feels so rewarding right now—!

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
――...Yes, you're right.
I am terribly sorry. ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Taaaaahhh—!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, phew...
Ahaha, my lungs are burning~...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Phew...
choice_data_list: You just finished a race, so don't overdo it.
You just finished a race, so don't push yourself, okay?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! But I still
have to meet my quota for today's solo training!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: With the next Tenno Sho (Spring) ahead, my current ability is still nowhere near enough.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: —Alright, I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Taaah~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next is finally the Tenno Sho (Spring).
I want to support her with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer, you should go on home ahead of me!
You must be tired~!
